headline: Broad beat and raised outlook on strong global demand
summary_short: Revenue rose 14% y/y to $1.96B and diluted EPS grew 22% to $4.28, both ahead of expectations, as gross margin expanded 140bp on AUR growth and favorable mix. Ralph Lauren raised its full-year Fiscal 2027 constant-currency revenue and operating-margin outlook on the strength of the quarter.
summary_long: Revenue grew 14% y/y (13% constant currency) to $1.96B, led by 24% growth in Asia and 13% in North America; AUR rose 15% on strong full-price selling. Gross margin expanded 140bp to 73.7% on AUR growth and favorable mix, outweighing tariff pressure. Adjusted operating margin rose 170bp to 18.7% as expense discipline offset higher marketing spend. Net income rose 19% y/y to $262M; diluted EPS rose 22% to $4.28 ($4.59 adjusted), while the tax rate rose to 23% on the absence of prior-year discrete benefits. Cash and short-term investments totaled $1.9B after ~$250M of buybacks; Ralph Lauren raised FY2027 constant-currency revenue guidance to 5-6% growth and operating-margin expansion guidance to 60-80bp.

drivers.explanation: Growth was led by 24% Asia growth (China +40%) and 13% North America growth, plus 15% AUR gains from strong full-price selling, per the release.
Gross margin expansion (+140bp to 73.7%) was driven by AUR growth and favorable channel/geographic mix, more than offsetting tariff and product-cost pressure.
Adjusted operating margin rose 170bp as strong full-price demand and expense discipline more than offset increased marketing investment, per the release.
Net income grew despite the effective tax rate rising to 23% from 21%, driven by the absence of prior-year discrete tax benefits.
Diluted EPS growth tracks the net-income and operating-margin gains; diluted share count fell slightly y/y (61.3M vs 62.5M) on continued buybacks.

Management framed the quarter as a strong start to year two of its 'Next Great Chapter: Drive' plan, with broad-based performance across geographies and channels, prompting the raised full-year outlook.
